summary_1line: Saunaka contrasts ignorant sensual living with the disciplined path to liberation; Yudhishthira worships the Sun seeking sustenance for accompanying Brahmanas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira stands waist-deep in the Ganges at sunrise, motionless in prayer as the blazing sun appears before him.
A man like an insect plunges toward a bright flame, symbolizing a soul drawn helplessly into the fire of desire.
The radiant sun-god manifests in the sky before the meditating king, surrounded by blazing light.
